plugins.name: pb-codegraph
plugins.description: Cross-module impact analysis for Magento 2 / Mage-OS — detect blast radius of code changes before deploy. v0.2.0 ships a deterministic codegraph-backed engine (augmenter + MCP shim, graph-backed find_symbol/context/impact/query tools) alongside the original v0.1.0 LLM-driven impact check (grep, magento2-lsp MCP, config XML parsing), auto-selected per project by the presence of a `.codegraph/codegraph.db` index. pps cutover acceptance-tested; awaiting sign-off before default rollout.
